# Blueprint

> Blueprint is a free, open-source Mac app that gives your AI a canvas. Tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex "/visualize this system" and it draws a clear map of the system in the app.

- Maps are made of cards, drawn visuals, operator symbols (A + B = C) and groups or layers.
- Lines come in nine kinds: flow, increases, decreases, requires, becomes, equals, versus, blocks, relates.
- Click any card or line to read what it means. Everything is editable by hand.
- Projects hold systems, systems hold visuals. All of it is stored as plain files in ~/Blueprint on your Mac.
- No account, no cloud, no model picker. It works with the AI subscriptions you already have, through a bundled MCP server.
- On first launch, one click connects Blueprint to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
- Requires macOS on Apple silicon.
- Source: https://github.com/CruceSaunders/blueprint
